detail.title: Pulse Tower Extension Board - 4 Sockets, 2 USB & 2 Type-C, LED Night Light
detail.overview: The Ant Pulse Tower is a vertical extension board combining 4 universal sockets with 2 USB and 2 USB Type-C ports, rated for 2500W / 10A to comfortably support home and office power needs. A built-in LED night light adds a soft, practical glow for bedside or hallway use after dark, while surge protection guards connected devices from power spikes. Its compact vertical tower design saves desk space compared to traditional flat strips, making it a well-rounded charging station for phones, laptops and everyday accessories in any home office setup.
